newsitem.title: USA: Giddings & Lewis elects Isles chairman.
newsitem.headline: Giddings & Lewis elects Isles chairman.

text.p: Giddings & Lewis Inc said Wednesday it elected Marvin Isles chairman of the board, replacing Joseph Coppola who will become vice chairman, a newly created position.
Isles currently serves as chief executive and president of Giddings & Lewis and will continue in those roles.
G & L said the board is reviewing Harnischfeger Industries Inc's unsolicited tender offer for Giddings & Lewis at $19 cash per share, as well as strategic alternatives for the company.

Because of the review, G & L said it named both Coppola and Clyde Folley, retired Vice Chairman and Chief Financial Officer of Ingersoll-Rand Co, as directors, increasing the number of directors to seven. Coppola and Folley intended to retire from the board at this year's annual meeting, held earlier Wednesday.
The company said Benjamin Garmer of the law firm of Foley & Lardner resigned from the board for personal reasons.
